title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: report.tex governing equations and solver.cpp residual/flux source implement compressible conservation; spatial scheme and output limitations are separately noted.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:48 and :270–282 read zones and TRI/QUAD sections, builds geometry and graph; general MIXED elements and multi-zone cases were not independently validated.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:455 onward assembles conservative face residuals; global norm reductions :616–620. All steady histories reach specified reductions, but formal order is not demonstrated.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:254 onward implements Rusanov; no Roe or higher-resolution flux is required, but large numerical drag indicates substantial limitations in supplied steady results.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp boundary_ghost_state and io.cpp:72–99 implement boundary states; no-slip output explicitly gives wall values. General boundary variants were not independently tested.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:768–775 zeros gradients and limiters on every steady iteration; second-order reconstruction/limiter is used only in transient. report.tex:91–93 and :561–564 disclose this; steady metadata nevertheless claims spatial_order_claimed=2.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:230–295 implements Barth–Jespersen and reconstruction; it is explicitly disabled in all steady runs and computed once per transient physical step. Report discloses this.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:399–452 computes viscous gradients and stress, but :645–689 integrates full stress vector without tangential projection; report calls this friction drag. Large reported laminar and Re20 drag limit credibility.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:500–607 implements scalar spectral-radius LU-SGS with local pseudo time; steady runs reach reported residual targets. Full discretization order and restart are separate limitations.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:840–898 implements BDF1/BDF2 full transient residual and inner iteration, with gradients frozen per physical step; metadata gives dt=0.01, t=300 and zero target misses. Residual CSV dt field remains zero and no unsteady rerun was performed.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and neighbor exchanges as above; np2/np8 original histories match closely for NACA and cylinder. Global mesh temporarily exists on all ranks during preprocessing, then local mesh is returned; no np1 full run verified.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
